topic: The Daring RAF Raid That Sank the Battleship Tirpitz
hook: During WWII, the Royal Air Force launched Operation Catechism, finally destroying Nazi Germany's most feared floating fortress, the battleship Tirpitz.

evidence.title: 1944, 11-12: Second World War: In Operation Catechism, the Royal Air Force sank the German battleship Tirpitz  (video featured) near Tromsø, Norway, killing about 1,000 sailors on board.

angle: Focus on the groundbreaking use of the 12,000-pound 'Tallboy' earthquake bomb, designed specifically by Barnes Wallis to collapse the seabed beneath the Tirpitz rather than just pierce its armor.
what_others_do: Existing videos typically focus on the broad narrative of the multiple operations and the persistence of the British bombers.
